Class TrackingSystem

java.lang.Object
TrackingSystem
public class TrackingSystem extends Object
The TrackingSystem class is responsible for managing and analyzing space objects. It provides methods to track objects by type or orbit, assess debris in orbit, and generate reports on orbital status and exited debris.

This class supports operations such as:

  • Tracking objects in Low Earth Orbit (LEO)
  • Assessing the orbital status of debris
  • Writing updated orbit assessments to a CSV file
  • Generating a report on debris that has exited orbit

    • assessDebrisInOrbit

      public void assessDebrisInOrbit()
      Assesses the orbital status of debris and prints a detailed report. The report includes whether debris is still in orbit, has exited orbit, or has an uncertain status, along with its risk level.

    • writeUpdatedOrbitCSV

      public void writeUpdatedOrbitCSV(String filename)
      Writes an updated orbit assessment to a CSV file. The CSV includes details about each debris object, its orbital status, and its risk level.
      Parameters:
      filename - the name of the CSV file to write

    • writeExitedDebrisReport

      public void writeExitedDebrisReport(String filename)
      Writes a report on debris that has exited orbit to a text file. The report includes details about each debris object and a summary of the counts of debris still in orbit and exited debris.
      Parameters:
      filename - the name of the text file to write
